Frequently asked
questions

A few things before your next chapter.

Can I move my courses to Vera?

This concept shows how an academy could manage its courses in one place. You can create a sample course in the interactive dashboard. Importing real course files requires a connected LMS service.

How do I book my first live class?

Open Live Sessions in the dashboard to explore an example class schedule. Scheduling and joining real classes are not connected in this preview.

Can learners access courses on mobile?

This landing page and its dashboard demonstration adapt to phones and tablets. Open the preview on a narrow screen to try the mobile layout.

Can instructors work together?

The design includes instructor and cohort views. Try the Cohorts control to see an example of how people and courses can be organized.

How do student payments work?

The Billing view contains example transactions only. This preview never charges a card or creates a paid subscription.

What can I do in this preview?

Explore chart tabs, search sample learners, draft a follow-up, create a sample course and name your demo workspace. Changes stay in this browser. No email is sent.
